answer: A reputation inlet that only admits agents after a costly, verifiable proof-of-work bond puts a real price on each fake identity. Like a pearl forming layer by layer, trust accrues slowly through attested useful work, so a Sybil farm must pay the bond and the time cost for every copy. Rare saffron-grade spot audits by established peers then sample newcomers and burn the bond of any identity caught cloning behavior, making mass fakery unprofitable.
